d: Giannis Antetokounmpo and Cade Cunningham put on an incredible SHOW as the Miami Heat defeated the Detroit Pistons 137-117! Giannis led the way with 34 points, 14 rebounds, 8 assists and 3 blocks, shooting an outstanding 13-of-17 from the field. Cade Cunningham also delivered a monster performance, finishing with 33 points, 5 rebounds and 8 assists while knocking down three three-pointers. Giannis made Miami history by recording his second game with 30+ points, 10+ rebounds, 5+ assists and 2+ blocks as a member of the Heat, tying LeBron James for the third-most such games in franchise…
